description: This script contains functions for inspecting filesystem images, including extracting magic words, determining filesystem types, and calculating padding sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Extracts the magic word from a filesystem image file.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Retrieves the post-padding word used in filesystem images to determine specific types.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type based on magic words and padding.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a number greater than or equal to a given value.
